concerns.text: Task T032 lists T031 (threshold detection) as a dependency, but T031 depends on T032 (aggregation) to function. This circular dependency violates the spec's requirement for a linear analysis pipeline (FR-005/FR-006) and blocks execution. T032 must depend only on T017 and T025.

T032 requires 'exactly 1000 resamples' for bootstrapping bin means, but SC-004 mandates 1000 resamples for the *threshold value* CI (handled in T031). T032 should perform aggregation without bootstrapping the threshold, or the task scope is conflated with T031, risking semantic weakening of the statistical rigor.

T012 states the generator produces 'a representative set' with 'varying complexity' but does not explicitly mandate the 'uniform distribution (at least 25 workflows per depth level)' required by US1 Acceptance Scenario 1 and T010. This is a semantic weakening of the FR-001 reproducibility requirement.

T038 sets the performance gate failure threshold at 21600 seconds (6 hours), but the Plan explicitly states a goal of 4 hours. This silently relaxes the resource constraint (SC-005) and allows a build to pass that is 50% slower than the target, violating the 'Resource-Constrained Execution Fidelity' principle.

Task T056 is defined twice with conflicting dependencies and placement (Phase 5 vs Phase N+3). This duplication creates ambiguity on the authoritative logic for edge-case handling, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle (Constitution Principle IV) and risking inconsistent implementation.
